info.name: Veeam Backup for AWS public API 1.0 Agents Object Restore Points API

params.name: skip
params.description: Number of restore points to skip.

params.name: limit
params.description: Maximum number of restore points to return.

params.name: orderColumn
params.description: Sorts restore points by one of the restore point parameters.

params.name: orderAsc
params.description: Sorts restore points in the ascending order by the `orderColumn` parameter.

params.name: createdAfterFilter
params.description: Returns restore points that are created after the specified date and time.

params.name: createdBeforeFilter
params.description: Returns restore points that are created before the specified date and time.

params.name: nameFilter
params.description: Filters restore points by the `nameFilter` pattern. The pattern can match any restore point parameter. To substitute one or more characters, use the asterisk (*) character at the beginning and/or at the end.

params.name: platformNameFilter
params.description: Filters restore points by name of the backup object platform.

params.name: platformIdFilter
params.description: Filters restore points by ID of the backup object platform.

params.name: backupIdFilter
params.description: Filters restore points by backup ID.

params.name: backupObjectIdFilter
params.description: Filters restore points by backup object ID.

items.docs: The HTTP GET request to the `/api/v1/objectRestorePoints` path allows you to get an array of all restore points created on the backup server.
The HTTP GET request to the `/api/v1/objectRestorePoints/{id}` path allows you to get a restore point that has the specified `id`.
The HTTP GET request to the `/api/v1/objectRestorePoints/{id}/disks` path allows you to get an array of disks from a restore point that has the specified `id`.
